_comment: #503 mobile touch smoke: title gesture, Continue, adjacent-tap talk, paged-dialogue taps, option taps, tap-to-walk, journal chip -- all via touch_* steps and nothing else. Native headless: emulated taps (qa_touch real:false). Web runner --touch (+ --device=iphone|android, --portrait-entry): every tap is a real page.touchscreen.tap performed by Playwright at the window pixel the driver publishes; an unserviced request FAILS the step, so a keyboard/mouse fallback cannot pass this script. Labelled EMULATED in the runner log -- never evidence about real hardware.

steps._comment: Every input in this script is a touch_* step: on the web build the Playwright runner performs a REAL page.touchscreen.tap at the window pixel the driver publishes; natively the tap is emulated by the mouse injector and the qa_touch event says so (real:false). There is no keyboard press and no click step anywhere below.
Title rows: 1 = New Game, 2 = Continue (fixture mobile_tap_start: inn (9,4), facing down, Lyonette at (9,5)).
Adjacent-tap interact: tapping the NPC's own cell is the click-to-walk path's interact arm. First interact this waking = the pool line; the second opens the graph.
Row 3 opens the 4-page order_brief node (qa_real_paging on, as mobile_tap_check); pages advance by panel taps.
Last page: option 1 ('How bad is it, really?') -> hub; hub option 2 ends the conversation (mobile_tap_check's down+confirm, by touch).
Tap-to-walk: one cell west is open floor; the walker lands there.
Field chip = the touch affordance for the journal; tap it open, tap it closed.
Field chip = the touch affordance for the journal; tap it open.
12 touches, every one of them the SAME kind: the count pins that no step silently took another input path. The web runner separately reports how many were REAL browser taps.
